fields.description: When enabled, uploading a resume or cover letter queues an AI analysis of the applicant against the Job Opening.
fields.label: Enable AI Screening

fields.description: Applicants scoring at or above this are moved to Shortlisted by AI for human review. Nobody is shortlisted without a human approving it afterwards.
fields.label: Shortlist Threshold Score

fields.description: Anthropic, OpenAI and Google are called directly. OpenRouter proxies many vendors behind one API/key -- pick it if you want a model not otherwise listed.
fields.label: Provider

fields.description: Model used to score applicants. Options are fetched live from the selected provider.
fields.label: Model

fields.description: Stored encrypted. Must be a key for the Provider selected above -- switching provider does not reuse this key.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Sends a trivial real request to the selected provider using the values currently in this form (even if not yet saved) and reports success or the exact error -- the fastest way to confirm Provider/Model/API Key are actually working together before any candidate is screened.
fields.label: Test Connection

fields.description: Off by default. When enabled, low-scoring applicants are emailed a regret automatically by the daily scheduler.
fields.label: Auto Send Regret Emails

fields.description: Applicants scoring below this may receive a regret email. Must be lower than the Shortlist Threshold — the gap between the two is a grey zone that HR decides manually.
fields.label: Regret Threshold Score

fields.description: Grace period after scoring before an automatic regret is sent, so HR has a window to review first.
fields.label: Send Regret After (Days)

fields.description: Maximum regret emails queued per scheduler run.
fields.label: Regret Batch Size

fields.description: Use bare placeholders, e.g. {{ applicant_name }}, {{ job_title }}, {{ custom_ai_score }} — any Job Applicant fieldname. A misspelt placeholder renders empty without raising an error, so use Send Test Email below before going live.
fields.label: Regret Email Template

fields.description: Sent to the candidate when HR approves and invites them for an interview. Placeholders may also use {{ interview_scheduled_on }}, {{ interview_from_time }}, {{ interview_to_time }}, {{ interview_type }}.
fields.label: Interview Invitation Template

fields.description: Renders a template against a real applicant so you can check the wording and placeholders before any candidate receives it.
fields.label: Send Test Email

fields.description: Its field values are used to fill the placeholders.
fields.label: Render Using Applicant

fields.description: Leave blank to send to yourself. The candidate is never emailed by this test.
fields.label: Send Test To
